Place them in a separate reference block. - If reference content exists, place image blocks adjacent to the most relevant reference block (above or below) based on reading context. - Add reasonable width if missing (e.g., `width="350"`). ## 4. Cleanup Rules - Remove metadata like [5점], [5점/단답형], [서답형], [서답형1], [객관식], [주관식], [단답형], [4점]. - Remove bracketed tags that include 점/형/배점/난이도 or similar exam metadata. - Remove stray occurrences of 서답형/단답형/객관식/주관식 even when not bracketed. - Fix obvious Korean typos in these metadata tags before removing them. ## 5. Limits (IMPORTANT) - Do NOT normalize LaTeX or math formatting in this step. - Do NOT rewrite math content or numeric values. - Keep choices/answer/solution text as-is except for metadata removal and minimal HTML wrapping needed for structure.
